notes.title: Gameplay Improvement
notes.content:
- Different speed levels in different weapons: Normal movement, Slow walking, Running, Bending, Valid in all game modes.

- Bullet from Weapon is now more pronounced (Beta)

- Different walking sounds and New walking sounds on different floors

- The distance from Flag and Sabotage Point is now visible in Conquest and Rush game mode

- Fixes on some Lines

- The game version was v0.42

notes.title: Hangar Map and Crosshair Customization Update
notes.content:
Hangar Map and Crosshair Customization Update


- New Map added "Hangar" =
Hangar (Conquest), Hangar (CTF), Hangar (TDM), Hangar (DM)

- Crosshair is now Customizable (with the "P" key in game)

- Some maps have been removed.
(Conquest, CTF, TeamDeathmatch, Deathmatch, VS Map)

- Now the Language customization part is saved.

- Settings-> Sound Settings now works smoother.

- Bomb throw distance, bounce, drag has been changed.

- Drop damage and screen darkening have been reduced.

- Most bugs fixed. (Gameplay, Interfaces etc ...)

- Lighting also changes.

- The game version was v0.35.

- And more...

notes.title: Animation Update
notes.content:
- The Animations of the 7 Weapons have been completely changed. (80+)

- Weapon Recoil rates have been changed.

- Reticle Size has been reduced.

- Sound levels have been adjusted.

- Barrel tip fire has been changed, the Bullet Case has been added, and the Blood Effect has been increased.

- Weapon Takedown time has been removed.

- Match Start time has been made 10 seconds.

- Some fixes in VS Map.

- Some bugs fix.

- The game version was v0.32.
